claim_limits: Actual exporter observations are obtained from signed synthetic intake and real application worker processing in a fresh disposable SQLite DB.
This profile does not monitor the retained native reference run, connect enterprise sources, prove the 24-hour SLA or verify browser rendering.
No TLS handshake, Docker engine, Prometheus/Grafana startup/query, alert interruption, recovery or shutdown execution is claimed by preparation or modeled tests.
entry_point: python -B -m integrations.monitoring.native_host execute --run FRESH_32_HEX_RUN --reviewed-source-sha256 REVIEWED_64_HEX_SOURCE --approval-reference FRESH_APPROVAL_REFERENCE --docker-reviewed-path EXPLICIT_REVIEWED_DOCKER_EXE --certificate-python REVIEWED_CERTIFICATE_RUNTIME
approval: A fresh approval must cover the actual command, executable, final source/controller/helper revisions, private preparation, cached-only startup, temporary dependency installation/migrations within the disposable container, independent watchdog and owned-only shutdown. Placeholders are deliberately nonfunctional. An approval reference is a record, not authority.
images: image-lock.json; exact linux/amd64 manifest and config digests; no pull/build/acquisition fallback

isolation.prometheus_and_grafana_network: container namespace of the exact current runner ID
isolation.listeners: 127.0.0.1 only within that namespace: exporter18843, Prometheus19090, Grafana13000
isolation.dns_or_external_egress: no routed interface in the namespace

capacity.acquisition: Image acquisition is separate and unapproved. The approximately603MiB compressed layers already exceed the512MiB runtime-only growth budget. Expanded image/VM footprint is unknown. Any acquisition needs a separate reviewed budget and fresh capacity against the unchanged original30GiB baseline. This controller requires all exact images already cached and never acquires them.

parent_reported_read_only_observation.limit: A parent-reported planning observation with an unknown reason for increased free capacity. It does not reset the baseline, certify current reserves, cache presence, peer state or launch readiness.

runtime_bounds.shutdown_limits: Container stop10s command bound/5s graceful stop, independent60s late-create drain. Launcher waits up to150s for the independent receipt. Private preparation is separately bounded, and all preparation growth is included in the stage baseline.

proof_actions: Install only the3 hash-verified retained wheels into runner tmpfs, migrate fresh SQLite, and start the actual TLS exporter with separately injected private Bearer auth.

Commit6 signed synthetic HTTP intake events, retry one identical event and submit one invalid signature; leave actual pending records while the named worker is deliberately paused. Without mocked clocks or backdated timestamps, require real pending/eligible gauges, oldest age, missing-worker state and local worker/queue alerts over actual elapsed time within180s. Then perform the real named-worker drain and reconcile processed records, an empty eligible queue, fresh pulse and alert clearing.
Require verified CA/IP TLS, missing/wrong exporter Bearer denial, wrong CA denial, missing Prometheus client certificate denial and unauthenticated Grafana API denial.
Observe successful native scrapes and match4 operational gauges with actual application counts, not hard-coded metric responses.

Fetch the provisioned dashboard through authenticated TLS and compare all12 Grafana datasource panel queries with native Prometheus series, timestamps and finite values at a bounded common query window. Preserve genuinely empty evidence.

Stop the actual exporter listener; observe native up=0 and the local MetricsUnavailable alert firing after its1m hold; restore the listener and require up=1, alert clearing and another12 panel comparisons.

Retain a bounded private proof receipt, or a closed partial receipt on a request/time/control failure; both launcher and independent watchdog revalidate exact ownership and stop only current stage containers. A failed control, capacity guard, interruption, receipt or shutdown cannot produce a passing host result.
remaining_holds: Fresh explicit native approval; no current authority to change the machine.
Final source freeze must include the forthcoming shared private-ACL numeric diagnostic revision; its native folder behavior remains unverified by this task.
Local presence and exact identity of all3 images have not been inspected. Missing images stop this cached-only controller; acquisition is a separate decision.

Eight unrelated workloads were previously reported running. The current peer state is unverified; any foreign running container refuses this exclusive-engine stage. No preservation launch or foreign shutdown is implemented.
Current host reserves and cumulative loss must be freshly measured against the original baseline. Image expansion and native memory/startup compatibility remain unknown.
Native command compatibility, TLS enforcement, datasource frame shapes, interruption timings, recovery, browser rendering and both actual shutdown checks remain mandatory.
Enterprise-source monitoring connection and the24-hour operational run remain separate work.
recovery: On any failure the independent watchdog writes an abort marker and drains only freshly verified stage-owned containers for60s. The launcher also revalidates owned-only stop. Retain the private run and receipts. Do not remove resources, retry, reset the baseline, stop peers or infer shutdown when the daemon is unreachable. A failed native attempt consumes its approval; any retry requires renewed review and approval.
